title: Dominican Dragon Portal
description: A surreal beach scene at dusk features a tattooed woman in a Dominican flag bikini sitting on a large fallen palm tree. A glowing blue demon with horns emerges from a stone archway in a rocky outcrop while two massive serpentine dragons with glowing accents fly overhead under a purple sky with meteors.
prompt: A cinematic fantasy beach scene at twilight with a beautiful tattooed Dominican woman wearing a flag bikini sitting on a fallen palm tree log. A blue horned demon emerges from a glowing stone portal archway covered in moss. Two giant glowing serpentine dragons with fiery outlines fly across a purple sky filled with shooting stars. Dominican flags are visible on the woman and held by a silhouetted figure on the rocks. Dramatic lighting, mystical atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
